result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The full test suite passes offline.

**What changed**
- `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`: the `PURCHASE_ORDERS` entry in `CustomerAttributedRecords` had an empty exclusion and counted cancelled orders on purpose. It now uses `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same predicate the quarterly purchase-order report uses. I also updated the enum and `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` javadoc to match.
- `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`: added `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted`. It covers your example: Anna has one live North order, Bob has one live and two cancelled South orders, and the report is `Anna:1, Bob:1`.

**Side effect to check:** the per-country purchase-order report (`findPurchaseOrderCountPerCountry`) shares that enum entry, so it also stops counting cancelled orders now. I didn't add a separate per-country test. If you want cancelled orders kept there, the fix is to give the per-rep query its own exclusion instead of changing the shared entry.

Nothing is committed.
